description: Open hand near forehead, then move it outward and forward in a slight wave. Palm faces outward.
Flat hand touches chin or lips, then moves outward and downward toward the person you are thanking.
Fist placed on chest, make circular motion. The movement expresses remorse or apology.
Hook index fingers together with both hands, then switch which hand is on top. Interlocking fingers symbolize friendship.
W handshape (three fingers) tapped twice on the chin. Chin represents drinking.
Flat O handshape moved to mouth twice, mimicking putting food in your mouth.
C handshape raised to mouth, tilting back as if drinking from a cup.
F handshape on both hands, move outward in a circle until pinkies touch. Circle represents a family unit.
Fist nods up and down, like a head nodding yes.
Index and middle finger quickly close against thumb twice, like a talking motion.
Open hand on chest, move in a circular motion. The heart area represents sincerity.
Thumbs-up fist rests on open palm, both hands move upward together.
Clap hands twice with dominant hand on top, fingers spread. Represents clapping in a classroom.
Flat O handshape touches cheek then moves to temple. Represents sleeping and eating at home.
Both arms crossed over chest, fists closed. Like hugging yourself to show love.
Flat hand touches lips or chin, then moves downward and forward. Good comes from the mouth.
Flat hand touches lips, then flips downward with palm facing down. Opposite of good.
Open 5-hand, thumb touches chin twice. Chin area represents female signs.
Open 5-hand, thumb touches forehead twice. Forehead area represents male signs.
Both palms pressed together in front of chest (prayer position), slight bow. Traditional Indian greeting.
